label: Sweet cream butter
note: Süßrahmbutter: pH above 6.4, the cream is not soured

about.text: Butter made from cream that has not been soured, with no lactic acid bacteria culture added. German law (Süßrahmbutter) sets its pH above 6.4; it is one type of butter beside cultured (Sauerrahmbutter) and mildly soured butter.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Cream is churned without any culture or ripening for flavour, so the butter tastes clean and creamy rather than tangy, and the buttermilk stays sweet.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Cream that is not soured and has no lactic acid bacteria culture added is churned.
